description.narrative: ACTION POUR LE DEVELOPPEMENT DURABLE The focus of this microproject is the development of fish farming integrated with market gardening. Fish farming integrated with market gardening is one of the most important socio-economic activities in the Maradi region. It contributes not only to food self-sufficiency, but also to increasing the cash income of those involved in these activities. The Maradi region in general has significant water resources, which are a source of income and employment not only for the direct farmers, but also for the region's population. The village of OURAFANE in the rural commune of Ourafane is home to a semi-permanent pond covering an area of around 2.7 hectares. Populations grouped into production structures practice fish farming and market gardening around this pond. This provides a high-quality source of nutrition, as well as substantial income for the farmers. However, this important resource is threatened by climatic hazards, leading to premature drying-up and a reduction in fish and vegetable production. Witha view to strengthening the water retention capacity of the pond and increasing production, the Ourafane local authorities deemed it useful and necessary to support the farmers through the implementation of this microproject. It is with this in mind that the NGO AGIR has developed the present project document. The aim of this micro-project is to make the fishermen's association more operational, notably through capacity-building actions, and thus contribute to increasing the production resulting from their activities. As a reminder, Axis 3 of the commune development plan (PDC) for the Ourafane commune is entitled: “Improving economic growth and employment, by improving economic potential, strengthening the vocationaland technical training system, and improving production in the agro-sylvo-pastoral system”. The formulation of this microproject's objectives, which take into account the improvement of the population's income, the promotion of employment and food and nutritional security, means that it fits in well with the commune's priorities as set out in the Communal Development Plan (PDC). In terms of the Microproject's compliance with national guidelines, it should be noted that it is perfectly in line with national guidelines, in particular the Programme de Résilience pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie (PRSP) 2024--2026 and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). This micro-project, which is in line with the commune's PDC and national guidelines, in particular the Programme de Résilience pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie (PRSP) 2024-2026, is highly relevant in that it is consistent with the priorities defined in the terms of reference of the call for proposals, namely taking into account the specific needs and constraints of the target population of the Ourafane commune. It is a project whose implementation is strongly encouraged and awaited by the technical services in charge of the area and the communal authorities, in view of the impact it will have on the population's cash income through the development and exploitation of a local fisheries resource. 2.1.1.1 ObjectivesThe overall objective of the microproject is to “contribute to improving the nutritional situation and increasing the monetary income of the Ourafane population through the development of the waterhole and the rehabilitation of the community fish farm” with the following specific objectives:  Enhance the Ourafane waterhole by carrying out development work; Rehabilitate the community fish farm; Increase farmers' income by diversifying market garden production; Improve the nutritional status of the population; Create jobs for young people. These objectives are to be achieved through the attainment of the following results:  the Ourafane pond is developed; the community fish farm rehabilitated farmers' incomes have increased thanks to the modernization and diversification of market garden production; people's nutritional status has improved; Jobs have been created for young people.

participating-org.narrative: An NGO called Action pour un Développement Durable (ADD) is hereby created in the Republic of Niger between the members of the present statutes.It is governed by law N°9106 of May 20, 1991, modifying and completing ordinance N°8406 of March 1, 1984, governing NGOs and Associations. The NGO is non-profit-making and apolitical.Its head office is in Niamey. It may be transferred to any place in the national territory by decision of the General Assembly (GA).MISSION:To contribute to the reinforcement of the capacity for self-promotion of the culture of citizenship within the populations with a view to participating effectively in the formulation and implementation of development policies at local, communal and regional level for the betterment of the populations.GENERAL OBJECTIVE:To contribute to and support all actions aimed at improving the living conditions of populations in a perspective of sustainable development.SPECIFIC OBJECTIVES:1. Initiate actions to support promising sectors in order to ensure food security and improve living conditions,2. Facilitate the emergence of opinion leaders within socio-professional groups with a view to self-promotion,3. Support initiatives by the State, local communities and development partners to promote education andliteracy,4. Support the development of quality products and services to meet the needs of local groups.
